title: Vance: Iran Must Cut Nuclear Enrichment Capacity for Any US Deal
detail: VP JD Vance declared that Iran must reduce its nuclear enrichment capacity as a precondition for any agreement with the United States, escalating diplomatic pressure amid stalled negotiations over Iran's nuclear program.

media.caption: Vance demands Iran cut nuclear enrichment as condition for US deal

title: Trump Warns Iran Could Target US Cities; Extra Nuclear Protections Deployed
detail: President Trump expressed concern that Iran could target US cities, with reports that specific US locations are receiving additional nuclear protection measures in response to the escalating threat assessment.
